title: Project path casing on Linux
root_cause: The workflow refers to src/Quiver/Quiver.csproj, while the directory at the failed commit is src/quiver. The Linux runner cannot resolve that spelling, although the earlier Windows jobs could resolve it on their case-insensitive filesystem. The differing runner labels prevent a fair baseline comparison.

relevant_evidence.why: The build command names the project and MSBuild reports that it cannot find it.
The workflow uses the uppercase directory spelling.
